summary.text: Shane Reeves is a Republican state senator representing Tennessee Senate District 14 (Bedford, Cannon, Moore and Rutherford Counties), a member of the 110th through 114th General Assemblies. He chairs the Senate Energy, Agriculture, and Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Reeves was born on January 18, 1968, and is a CEO and pharmacist with a Bachelor of Science and a Doctor of Pharmacy degree.
He is married and has three children.
He is a past president of the Rutherford County Chamber of Commerce and of Leadership Rutherford, and a past chairman of Tennessee's National Federation of Independent Business.
His page lists the 2003 Tennessee Young Pharmacist of the Year award and the Rutherford Chamber of Commerce Business People of the Year award in 2012.
